description: Vad, Andreas and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. Two actual code repositories are deposited: a wind-farm response framework and a simulation-data postprocessor for surrogate creation. Environmental conditions and turbine setpoints drive power and fatigue predictions. The supporting methodology combines wake-aware flow, aeroelastic simulations and response surrogates, and tests reference plus anonymized commercial turbines in a six-turbine configuration. The associated inflow and output databases are already catalogued as data. Software and datasets retain separate identities and licences; no execution or archive inspection was performed. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under mit-license. The source explicitly identifies existing computational software. No code, archive, documentation body or software execution was inspected. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The software complements the separately catalogued TWAIN inflow and response datasets.
